script.title: ASKING FOR AN EARLY CHECK-IN
script.scene_zh: 飯店櫃台 · 請求提早入住
script.story_hook: A tired guest arrives long before the check-in hour.
script.intro_zh: 累壞的旅客在入住時間前很久就到了飯店。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, night owls! Today we're checking in early.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，夜貓子朋友們！今天我們要練習提早入住。
script.outro: Good night from us! Listen again before your next trip.
script.outro_zh: 我們晚安囉！下趟旅行前再聽一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each sentence once more together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起再把每句跟讀一遍。

script.char_b_description: a meticulous hotel receptionist, a tidy man in his late fifties with neatly combed steel-gray hair parted at the side, rimless glasses, a charcoal waistcoat, and a polished brass name tag
script.youtube_title: 【🌙紅眼航班英文】「房間還沒整理好」怎麼辦？🧳☕行李寄存・咖啡招待・鑰匙拿到聽完就會用｜Early Check-In English
script.youtube_title_en: “On the House” — Asking for Early Check-In After a Red-Eye
script.youtube_description:
紅眼航班一早落地，飯店三點才能入住，該怎麼開口請求？這段櫃台對話教你問提早入住、寄存行李、等待小確幸。18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，累到不行也能把話說清楚。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Your red-eye lands at dawn, but check-in is at three — what do you say? This front-desk dialogue covers asking for early check-in, storing luggage, and waiting gracefully. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA plus a listen-and-repeat finish. Check in calm on tired days.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🌙提早入住英文｜請求早入住・行李寄存・咖啡招待｜聽完就會商量｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
紅眼航班清晨落地，人快散架了，房間卻要下午三點才能給？
不敢開口商量，只好在大廳枯坐整個上午嗎？

這一集帶大家走進清晨六點半的飯店大廳，跟著旅客從請求提早入住、寄存行李，到喝到一杯招待咖啡、拿到樓上房間的鑰匙，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🛎️ 請求提早入住：例如 “I'm hoping for an early check-in.”、“Normal check-in is at three.”。
🧳 行李寄存與等待：例如 “Could you hold my luggage?”、“We can store bags, no charge.”。
☕ 收到善意招待：例如 “Coffee downstairs is on the house.”、“You're a lifesaver!”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次累著趕到飯店，記得開口問——禮貌地商量，通常都有解法！
script.thumbnail_action: leaning on the counter with a tote bag

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I'm hoping for an early check-in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrn·ɪŋ aɪm ˈhoʊ·pɪŋ fər ən ɜr·li ˈtʃɛk·ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我希望能提早入住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! What name is the reservation under?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛl·kəm wʌt neɪm ɪz ðə ˌrɛ·zərˈveɪ·ʃən ˈʌn·dər/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問預訂是用什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪ·nə ˈwɪt·fiːld koʊd ˌdʌb·ə·lju ˌeɪtʃ ˈsɛ·vən tu tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks! Our check-in starts at three, I'm afraid.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ɑʊr ˈtʃɛk·ɪn stɑrts æt θri aɪm əˈfreɪd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！恐怕我們的入住時間三點才開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, um, my red-eye just landed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ʌm maɪ ˈrɛdˌaɪ dʒʌst ˈlænd·ɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，呃，我那班紅眼航班才剛落地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's rough. Let me see what's free.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts rʌf lɛt mi si wʌts fri/
dialogue.zh: 噢，真辛苦。讓我看看還有沒有空房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If not, could you hold my luggage?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf nɑt kʊd ju hoʊld maɪ ˈlʌɡ·ɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 如果沒有，可以幫我寄存行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can store bags, no charge at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn stɔr bæɡz noʊ tʃɑrdʒ ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以收行李，完全不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That would help — I'm still pretty groggy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʊd hɛlp aɪm stɪl ˈprɪ·ti ˈɡrɑ·ɡi/
dialogue.zh: 那很有用——我整個還昏昏沉沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One quiet room is almost cleaned, hold on.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkwaɪ·ət rum ɪz ˈɔlˌmoʊst kliːnd hoʊd ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 有一間安靜的房快打掃好了，請稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush at all. Should I wait downstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ ət ɔl ʃʊd aɪ weɪt ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 一點也不用急。我在樓下等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's coffee downstairs; it's on the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ˈkɔ·fi ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz ɪts ɑn ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 樓下有咖啡，由飯店招待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, coffee sounds perfect right now.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，咖啡現在聽起來太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go — floor five, room 508.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ flɔr faɪv rum faɪv ˈoʊ ˈeɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, it's ready already? You're a lifesaver!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪts ˈrɛ·di ɔːlˈrɛ·d·i jʊr ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪ·vər/
dialogue.zh: 等等，已經好了？你真是我的救星！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've all been there after a red-eye.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːv ɔl bɪn ðɛr ˈæf·tər ə ˈrɛdˌaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 搭過紅眼航班的人都懂那種累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, truly. Enjoy your shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ ˈtru·li ɪnˈdʒɔɪ jɔr ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 真的很感謝您。值班愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Dana! Sleep well — dial zero anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈdeɪ·nə slip wɛl daɪəl ˈzi·roʊ ˈɛ·niˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，Dana！好好睡，有事隨時撥零。
